entry.label: Start
entry.summary: Where every run starts: the values it needs to begin.

settings.event_types: With an event trigger: the keys of the event types that start it.
settings.cron: With a schedule trigger: a five-field cron expression.
settings.timezone: An IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/London.
settings.input_schema: With a manual trigger: a JSON Schema of the input whoever starts it gives; {} takes anything.

entry.hands_on: The run's input, as its input_schema declares.

agent.label: Agent
agent.summary: An agent works on the run's data with your instructions.

settings.model: One of the models Forge offers (its model provider configuration's): the provider's key and the model's id. Both empty: the default.
settings.thinking_level: How long the model thinks before it answers: the level if the model offers it, else the nearest it does. Empty: the model's own.
settings.output_schema: With json output: a JSON Schema, as text.

agent.hands_on: Its answer as text; with output "json", the object its output_schema declares.

approval.label: Approval
approval.summary: The run waits for a person to approve or reject.

hands_on.comment: string — What they said, if anything.

http.label: HTTP request
http.summary: Calls a URL and hands on the response.

settings.body: A JSONata expression making the body; an object or list is sent as JSON.
settings.output_schema: A JSON Schema of the response's body; {} leaves it undeclared.

hands_on.headers: object — The response's headers, by lowercase name.
hands_on.body: any — The response's body: parsed when it's JSON, else text.

transform.label: Transform
transform.summary: Reshapes data with a JSONata expression.

settings.expression: A JSONata expression: what the step hands on.
settings.output_schema: A JSON Schema of what it makes; {} leaves it undeclared.

transform.hands_on: What its expression makes; with an output_schema, that shape.

delay.label: Delay
delay.summary: Waits a while before going on.

subworkflow.label: Run workflow
subworkflow.summary: Runs another of the organization's workflows.
subworkflow.hands_on: With wait, the other workflow's result; without, {run_id}.

if.label: If / else
if.summary: Takes one of two ways, on a condition.

settings.condition: A JSONata expression; true takes the True way.

if.hands_on: {branch}; later steps' previous is what came into it.

switch.label: Switch
switch.summary: Routes on one value: to the case it equals.

settings.value: A JSONata expression; the case it equals (as text) is taken.

outputs.each: cases[].id, one way out per case

switch.hands_on: {branch}; later steps' previous is what came into it.

match.label: Match
match.summary: Routes to the first rule whose condition holds.

settings.arms: In order: the first rule whose JSONata condition is true is taken.

outputs.each: arms[].id, one way out per rule

match.hands_on: {branch}; later steps' previous is what came into it.

loop.label: Loop
loop.summary: Runs its body once for each item in a list.

settings.items: A JSONata expression giving a list.

hands_on.count: integer — How many items it went through.

merge.label: Merge
merge.summary: Waits for the ways coming into it, then goes on as one.
merge.hands_on: An object keyed by the IDs of the steps that came into it, each holding what that step handed on.

end.label: End
end.summary: Finishes the run, as succeeded or failed, with a result.

settings.result: A JSONata expression giving the workflow's result.

end.hands_on: Nothing: it ends the run, whose result is its result expression.
